desc: Implement and verify the offline sweep over queries sorted by prefix endpoint.
Prove that `bisect_left` maintains tails for strictly increasing subsequences and that `bisect_right(tails, X)` gives the constrained LIS length.
Check duplicate values, queries with \(X\) below most values, \(R=1\), and answer restoration.
Validate \(O((N+Q)\log N)\) time and memory bounds.
